items.text: Ja, naš Baba-jan je zelo lačen spoštovanja.
items.q: Ghassem says sarcastically that their father hungers for respect. Does 'lačen spoštovanja' sound natural?

items.text: Joj, Nini je naenkrat postala zaspana. Od jutra sem pokonci brez spanca.
items.q: Maman, calling herself Nini, the family's pet name for her, says she suddenly feels sleepy. Does this sound natural?
before: Maman močno stisne oči in reče:

items.text: Ko se nauči naših imen, ji bomo všeč.
items.q: A boy spray-painting their names says the girl will like them once she learns the names. Does this line read correctly?
before: Yaser je s sprejem, ki ga je suknil iz očetovega tovornjaka, na zid nasproti Negarine hiše pisal naša imena in govoril:

items.text: Kaj hočeš, Eskandar? Kaj te je?
items.q: Hooman snaps at an annoying roommate: what the hell is wrong with you? Does this sound as rude as a young man would be?
before: – Ali res misliš, da ti to ime pristoji? Temu dlakavemu telesu, temu obrazu, oboroženemu do zob z brado in dlako. Če si ti Hooman, sem jaz Suzana.

items.text: Kakšna razlika? Če pride McCain, bo Iran spravil v ruševine, objektivno povedano.
items.q: Sajad says crudely that McCain would fuck Iran up. Does this sound as crude as a young man would say it?
before: – Orlov Pogled, ne vznemirjaj se toliko, mleko ti bo presahnilo. Ali bo Obama ali oni drugi, kaj to vpliva na tebe in mene?

items.text: Nastal je konec sveta. Ljudje iz Bibine generacije so govorili: ko pride konec sveta, se zemlja ves čas trese.
items.q: Maman says it is the end of days, as the old people of Bibi's day used to say. Does this sound like her?

items.text: Raje bi delil sobo z njimi kakor s kurčevcem, kot si ti.
items.q: Hooman tells a roommate he'd rather room with anyone than a dick-brain like him. Does 'kurčevcem' work as a crude insult?
before: – Prednjačenje Univerze AmirKabir v študentskih gibanjih je z ničemer primerljivo. Tudi če na Sharifu obstaja zbor tako imenovanih elit, iz katerih doslej ni prišla niti ena sama revolucionarna teorija.

items.text: No, če pa nisi tip, da bi se prijavljal in odhajal, zakaj si si pretrgal rit z opravljanjem izpita TOEFL?
items.q: Hooman asks crudely why Amir busted his ass on an English exam if he never meant to leave. Does this sound natural?
before: In zasmejal se je. Nič nisem rekel. Hooman je nadaljeval:

items.q: A boy leading a pretend mission announces the step onto the main street with a little sound. Does 'cik-cak' sound natural here?
before: Vedno sem ubogal Maman. Ubogal sem tudi Ghassema. Govoril je:

items.text: Hej, zakaj si vrgel palico stran? S čim bomo potem pozvonili?
items.q: A boy scolds his little brother for throwing away the stick they use to ring doorbells. Does it sound like a child?
before: Vedno sem pobral palico od drevesa tam. Vlekel sem jo po steni. Dajala je zvok motorja. Ghassem in Omid sta šla naprej. Jaz sem bil daleč zadaj. Ghassem me ni karal. Enkrat je rekel:

items.text: Zaobljubila sem se, da bom, če mu bo bolje, peš romala v Mašhad.
items.q: Maman made a religious vow to walk to the shrine city if her son recovers. Does this line read correctly?
before: …ki je sedel v dnevni sobi pred televizorjem in luščil bučna semena, in Maman, ki je sedela ob njem. Poročila so govorila o škodi zaradi obsežnih poplav v severnih in zahodnih provincah dežele. Od zadaj se mi je Maman zazdela kakor majhen krog, ki sedi ob večjem pravokotniku. Maman je govorila:

items.text: Muho in tisto drugo bedno zablodelo nadlogo.
items.q: Hooman recalls the two odd roommates they got: Fly and another deluded pest. Does this read correctly and naturally?
before: – In v tisti zasrani situaciji, kakšne starine so nam pripadle?

items.text: Bojim se, da bo postal kot tisti njegov prijatelj, Hamid.
items.q: Maman worries her son will end up like his poet friend Hamid. Does this line read correctly?
before: Mahboubeh se je zasmejala in Maman je rekla:

items.text: Jebenec. Objektivno, dolar bo kmalu 1500 tomanov, ti pa se ubaduješ s tistim nesrečnežem?
items.q: Sajad, who says 'Objektivno' all the time, scolds a roommate for pestering someone. Does this sound natural?
before: Sajad je zaprl prenosnik in zakričal:

items.text: Pošljite salavat. Starešina Krčme je končno nekaj rekel.
items.q: Hooman mocks quiet Amir as if a miracle happened: the Elder finally spoke. Does this tease sound natural?
